title: fix(spec): a bound action's translation is read only under its own object, never from globalActions
body:
Fixes #21261

Clause-②: no

## What changes

The spec i18n resolver now reads an action's translated copy at one address, chosen by the action's own `objectName`. This implements triage ruling (a) on the card (comment 5942994297). The key is the action's own `objectName`, never the caller's object:

- a bound action reads only `objects.OBJECT._actions.ACTION`;
- an object-less action reads only `globalActions.ACTION`.

A bound action no longer falls back to `globalActions`. That is the scope the `TranslationDataSchema.globalActions` docblock declares ("Global (object-less) action translations"). `os validate` already refuses the key at error level. The new private helper `actionTranslationNode` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`) is the one predicate. Every action lookup reads its leaf off that node.

The four sites that read `globalActions` at base `1371dc980c`, measured with `grep -n globalActions` on the file (4 code reads, at lines 563, 612, 716 and 744). All four now go through the helper:

1. `lookupActionField` (label / description / confirmText / successMessage), read at `:563`.
2. `lookupActionResultDialogNode`, read at `:612`.
3. `resolveActionOutcomeMessages`, read at `:716`.
4. `lookupActionParamNode`, read at `:744`.

There is no fifth site. Repo-wide, `git grep globalActions` over `packages/**/src` finds no other runtime reader. The CLI extractor (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`) is the producer, and it already writes a bound action's keys under `objects.OBJECT._actions`. The header docblock (`:32`–`:44`) and the docblocks on the lookups now say the global key is read only for an object-less action, and they name the declaration.

`translateObject`'s inline actions are unchanged. An inline action is scoped to the object that declares it, so it is bound and does not reach `globalActions` either. The new tests pin this.

## Pins (all four lookups, both directions)

`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts`, describe "translateAction — the copy address is keyed on the action's own objectName". Every row reads all four lookups off one `translateAction` result. Each bundle is parsed by `TranslationDataSchema`, so an author can write it.

| Action | Copy at | Result |
|---|---|---|
| bound to `support_case` | `globalActions.close_case` only | source text (and `resolveActionLabel` answers the source label) |
| bound to `support_case` | `objects.support_case._actions.close_case` | overlay |
| bound to `support_case` | `objects.support_queue._actions.close_case` | source text |
| object-less | `globalActions.close_case` | overlay |
| object-less | `objects.support_case._actions.close_case` | source text |
| inline on object `support_case` (via `translateMetadataDocument('object', …)`) | `globalActions` only, then owner-scoped | source text, then overlay |

There is no spec counterpart to objectui#3372's case: an object-less action rendered on an object's bar, with the caller passing an object. The spec resolver takes no caller object for a standalone action document. Only `translateObject` scopes an action to a host, and that is an inline action, which is bound by declaration. The object-less row above is this repository's half of that control.

**Fixture triage.** `packages/spec/src/ui/action-outcome-messages.test.ts` pinned the retired branch. Its test "falls back object-scoped → globalActions per outcome" asserted that a bound action (`sys_environment`) reads `globalActions.delete_environment.outcomeMessages.destroyed`. It is **replaced**: the same bundle now asserts that the bound action keeps its authored `destroyed` copy. The `globalActions` entry stays in the fixture as the negative.

**Ablation (committed fix, then mutation, then restore).** I put the fallback back into `actionTranslationNode` with `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor 1 → 0, marker 0 → 1, blob `81d7299d3bcc` → `ec08660ba646`. The test imports `./i18n-resolver` relatively, so no `dist/` is on its path. Expected direction: red. Observed: **3 failed | 323 passed** across `i18n-resolver.test.ts` and `action-outcome-messages.test.ts`: the bound/global-only row, the inline row and the replaced outcome row. Restore: `git checkout HEAD -- ABS_PATH`. Proved by blob `81d7299d3bcc` == the HEAD blob and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## The lint message (re-read, unchanged)

`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts:1575`–`:1578` reads: "Action X is bound to object OWNER, so the resolver looks it up under `objects.OWNER._actions.X` — never under `globalActions`, which is only consulted for object-less actions. This key is never read." Every sentence is now true of the spec resolver. The lint file stays out of the diff. The console reader (objectui `useObjectLabel` `actionSuffixes`) still appends the global key for a bound action until objectstack-ai/objectui#11439 lands. That is the objectui half, and this PR does not edit objectui.

## Census (before retiring)

Positive control: `git grep -c globalActions -- 'examples/**'` returns 6, all in `examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/index.ts`.

| Tree | Path | Key | Action binding | Disposition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| objectstack `1371dc980c` | `examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/index.ts` (en and zh-CN) | `globalActions.showcase_portfolio_snapshot` | object-less (`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/index.ts`: "NO objectName") | not a hit; stays |
| objectstack `1371dc980c` | 138 tracked files under `**/translations/**`, including the platform-objects bundles and the other `*.generated.ts` bundles | none | n/a | 0 hits |
| objectui `7728c67` and pin `31971ff1e28f` | `apps/console/src/preview-samples.ts:492` (the translation preview sample) | `globalActions.close_order` | bound: `objectName: 'sales_order'` at `:191` | **report-only** for objectstack-ai/objectui#11439 |

No objectstack bundle moves, so no generated translations file is touched.

## Liveness ledger (published in `@objectstack/spec`'s `files[]`)

Three ledger texts described the retired fallback. This change made them false, so they are corrected here:

- `packages/spec/liveness/translation.json`, `globalActions`: the evidence is repointed to `#actionTranslationNode`, the note now says the group is read only for an object-less action, and `verifiedAt` is set to 2026-10-02;
- `packages/spec/liveness/translation.json`, `objects`: the `_actions` evidence and the note;
- `packages/spec/liveness/action.json`, `outcomeMessages`: the `translateAction` evidence parenthetical.

`check:liveness` is green. These files were not in the claim's declared file surface. The report names that.

## Changeset

`.changeset/21261-bound-action-global-fallback.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': patch`, `Clause-②: no`. No accept set widens or narrows. `TranslationDataSchema` parses the same input, and the lint is unchanged. The resolver stops honouring a key outside the declaration that the authoring doors already refuse at error level. That is a bug fix in a released package, so it takes `patch` (AGENTS.md, Post-Task Checklist step 3). The changeset gives the one-line fix for a bundle that kept such a key. It also notes that a translation stored at runtime is not checked by that lint rule (`validateTranslationReferences` declares no `runtimeTypes`, so it runs only on `flow` writes), so such a translation changes the same way.

## Verification (opened at `272a47c3b5`, patched to `97432a19`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: exit 0.
- Targeted spec tests: `i18n-resolver.test.ts`, `i18n-resolver.object-list-views.test.ts`, `i18n-resolver.nav-label-identity.test.ts`, `action-outcome-messages.test.ts`, `action-description.test.ts` and `translation.test.ts`. Result: 6 files, 498 tests passed.
- Spec suite chunk `src/system src/ui`: 144 files, 5257 tests passed.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derived 85 commands from the merge base. 84 exit 0. That includes three re-runs after their `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` exit 3 was cleared by a build: `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. **NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:type-check-debt`.** It is a whole-tree tsc re-measure, and it was killed by the foreground cap at about 570s twice. It is left to CI.
- **Completed after the PR opened, at `272a47c3` (dev report `5946571239` on #21261):**
  - the whole spec local project in three chunks: 597 files, every test passed;
  - spec `typecheck` and `check:generated`: exit 0;
  - consumer tests: `rest` 294, `runtime` 682, `service-i18n` 16, `plugin-approvals` 6, `objectql` 6, all passed.
- **Patch round 1, head `97432a19`** (at-tier record `5946714800` ③; dev report on #21261):
  - the `ActionSchema.outcomeMessages` TSDoc (`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`) now states the action's one address instead of the retired object-then-`globalActions` order;
  - spec `build`, `typecheck`, `check:generated`, `check:docs`, `check:liveness`, `check:doc-authoring` and `check:nul-bytes`: exit 0;
  - `dispatch-gates --ran`: 86 families, 85 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (`check:type-check-debt`; CI's `Type Check · debt ledger` is the reading).

## Acceptance notes

- The runtime publish door does not run `translation-target-unknown` on a translation write, because `validateTranslationReferences` has no `runtimeTypes`. A translation stored at runtime can therefore carry any key the lint refuses, and the resolver silently never reads it. A bound action's `globalActions` key now joins that set. I did not measure a producer that writes this shape at runtime, so this is noted rather than filed. The seat ruled it out of this card's scope in writing (`5946727290` on #21261).
- objectui's `useObjectLabel-globalAction.test.tsx` docblock says it "Mirrors the canonical `@objectstack/spec` resolver (`lookupActionField`): object-scoped wins, global is the fallback." That stops being true with this PR. It is objectui#11439's to update together with `actionSuffixes`.
